name: @pipeworx/mcp-zoho_crm

tools.name: zoho_list_records
tools.description: List records from a Zoho CRM module (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals).

module.description: Module name (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts)

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return (e.g., "Last_Name,Email,Phone"). Defaults to common fields.

tools.name: zoho_get_record
tools.description: Get a single record by ID from a Zoho CRM module.

tools.name: zoho_search_records
tools.description: Search records in a Zoho CRM module using criteria.

tools.name: zoho_create_record
tools.description: Create a new record in a Zoho CRM module.

tools.name: zoho_list_modules
tools.description: List all available modules in Zoho CRM.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-zoho_crm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the zoho_crm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
